status: Packed YUV storage/upload/fill implemented. Original DDraw1 reaches Clipper reference validation; overall Wine acceptance incomplete.
changes: Enable DirectDraw YUY2/UYVY layout membership and allocate two bytes per logical pixel with four-byte paired storage geometry.
Expand odd lock/upload edges to shared chroma pairs; preserve logical dimensions and upload complete native pairs, including odd-width tails.

Fill CPU-authoritative YUV raw bytes, preserve neighboring pixels and padding, and retain upload debt on failure. GPU blits into YUV destinations remain explicitly unsupported; no complete YUV destination conversion is claimed.
Match native compressed COLORFILL and packed-YUV/compressed ROP refusal codes.

Restore the stale shared-format regression: test the active shared API8 helper instead of removed pre-refactor D3D8 functions; retain frozen baseline format ranges and record new YUV/depth membership as explicit extensions.
